module_summary: fntsys.cpp is the FreeType text system: a FontSystem object with 16 font slots, per-font glyph caches paged by codepoint (256 entries per page), up to four 256x256 T8 atlases per font, one CLUT, one semaphore shared by the GUI thread (draw/measure) and the IO worker (font loads), plus the fnt* C API with fit/marquee (fntRenderStringFit), word wrap (fntWrapText) and in-place wrap (fntFitString). grid.cpp/grid.h draw the Grid theme view (pages of covers, case flip with a COV2 back-cover cache, page slide, device sidebar); psbbnflow.cpp/psbbnflow.h draw the PSBBN Game Collection flow with hand-built triangle fans into static vertex arrays; plasma.cpp is the 32x32 perlin-noise background updated 6 rows a frame with VU0 helpers; renderman.h declares the renderer API (640x480 virtual space scaled to the native mode).

reusable_helpers.name: fntRenderStringFit
reusable_helpers.what: draws text in a fixed-width window: truncates with '...' or scrolls it as a marquee, binary-searching the cut point

reusable_helpers.name: fntWrapText
reusable_helpers.what: word-wraps UTF-8 text to a pixel width into an output buffer, breaking long words and CJK/Thai per character

reusable_helpers.name: fntFitString
reusable_helpers.what: in-place word wrap by replacing spaces with newlines at a pixel width

reusable_helpers.name: PlasmaBackground::ease
reusable_helpers.what: table-driven quintic smoothstep 0..1, also used by screen fade transitions

reusable_helpers.name: psbbnFlowRoundRect
reusable_helpers.what: outline points of a rounded rectangle for triangle fans

reusable_helpers.name: psbbnFlowCrop
reusable_helpers.what: centre-crop UV window of a texture to a square

findings.title: fntLoadDefault never sets a char size on the new default face (updateAspectRatioLocked runs while the font is still a local)
findings.problem: loadSlotLocked ends in updateAspectRatioLocked, which only calls FT_Set_Char_Size on fonts_[i]; loadDefault loads into the local newFont and copies it into fonts_[FNT_DEFAULT] afterwards, so the new default face has no size until some later fntUpdateAspectRatio or fntLoadFile. fntInit loads the built-in font this way: the __OPLDIAG autolaunch screen (opl.cpp:1944-1952) draws FNT_DEFAULT straight after fntInit, and the boot splash draws its version and status lines (guisplash.cpp:102-107) before _loadConfig reaches applyConfig's guiUpdateScreenScale. With no size, FreeType 2.14 loads glyphs unscaled and drops FT_LOAD_RENDER, so those glyphs are cached as valid but have no bitmap.
findings.fix: Move the updateAspectRatioLocked() call out of loadSlotLocked: call it in loadDefault after the memcpy into fonts_[FNT_DEFAULT], and in loadFile after a successful loadSlotLocked.
findings.justification: It moves an existing call rather than adding logic, at the cost of one extra line: the call has to run once the new font is in fonts_, otherwise the default face is never sized. This is the smallest correct fix.
findings.benefit: Text drawn with the default font between fntInit and the first guiUpdateScreenScale is drawn at the right size instead of blank (the FreeType no-size behaviour is INFERRED from the 2.14.1 SDK version; the missing FT_Set_Char_Size is READ). Net +1 line.
findings.evidence: Read fntsys.cpp:393-412 (loadSlotLocked -> updateAspectRatioLocked), 489-511 (newFont is a local, memcpy after), 648-677 (loop over fonts_ only). grep FT_Set_Char_Size|FT_Set_Pixel_Sizes|FT_Request_Size over the repo: only fntsys.cpp:674. grep fntUpdateAspectRatio: only gui.cpp:458 (Gui::updateScreenScale), called from settingsio.cpp:2523 (applyConfig), opl.cpp:358, guisettings.cpp. Boot order opl.cpp:1676-1719: lngInit (lang.cpp:454 fntInit), thmInit (internal theme, no fntLoadFile since themePath NULL, themes.cpp:1575-1576), splash at 1717-1718, then _loadConfig. OPLDIAG path opl.cpp:1944-1952 renders right after fntInit. FreeType version 2.14.1 from the installed SDK freetype.h; the NO_SCALE/RENDER behaviour of FT_Load_Glyph is from FreeType source knowledge, not read here.

findings.title: Kerning code in renderString, renderSubRTL and calcDimensionsLocked never runs: `previous` starts at 0 and is only set inside `if (... && previous)`
findings.problem: Each loop sets previous = 0 and guards the kerning block with `use_kerning && previous`, and the only assignment to previous is inside that block, so the condition is always false and FT_Get_Kerning is never called. Kerning was never applied (an inherited OPL bug). Draw and measure agree only because neither one kerns. The built-in PoeVeticaNew.ttf has no 'kern' table anyway.
findings.fix: Delete the kerning blocks, the use_kerning/previous/glyph_index/delta state (GlyphRun fields and calcDimensionsLocked locals) and delta_x in the RTL renderString, plus the 'so kerning stays exact' remark at fntsys.cpp:1085. This keeps the current rendering exactly.
findings.benefit: ~45 lines removed; no rendering change, because the code never executes (READ). FT_Get_Kerning may be dropped from the link (INFERRED, small).
findings.evidence: Grep kerning|previous|glyph_index|delta in fntsys.cpp: previous is assigned only at 755, 889 and 1228 (= 0) and at 782, 843, 915 and 1251, all inside `if (use_kerning && previous)`. GlyphRun fields are at fontsystem.h:97-99, and no other file touches them. A Python read of third_party/fonts/PoeVeticaNew.ttf finds no 'kern' or GPOS table (upem 2048).

findings.title: Glyph cache pages of 256 entries (9 KB each) make CJK text cost ~0.7 MB of mostly empty cache per font
findings.problem: The cache is paged by codepoint/256, and each page is malloc'd whole: 256 x 36-byte entries = 9,216 B. CJK ideographs are spread over U+4E00-9FFF, so a few hundred distinct characters touch dozens of pages, each almost empty. Pages are freed only when the font is flushed. Counting the codepoints in lng/fork/Japanese, SChinese and TChinese.yml gives 74, 76 and 81 distinct pages: 666-729 KB per font once those strings have been drawn, for 578-746 used entries.
findings.fix: Lower GLYPH_CACHE_PAGE_SIZE to 32. The code already uses only the constant (/ and %). Optionally also narrow the entry's int fields to short.
findings.benefit: INFERRED from the lang files: at 32 entries a page is 1,152 B, so 239-340 pages = 269-382 KB instead of 666-729 KB per CJK font (~350-400 KB saved per font in the worst case). Latin fonts save ~10-18 KB each. The pointer array grows to at most 8 KB.
findings.evidence: Read fontsystem.h:22 (GLYPH_CACHE_PAGE_SIZE 256) and 43-59 (entry: 7 ints + 2 pointers = 36 B on the 32-bit EE), and fntsys.cpp:187-221 (page malloc of 256 entries) and 593-602. grep GLYPH_CACHE_PAGE_SIZE: used only at fntsys.cpp:155, 209, 214, 594, 595. A Python count of distinct (codepoint // N) over lng/fork/*.yml: Japanese 74 pages at 256, 239 at 32; SChinese 76 / 305; TChinese 81 / 340; Korean 43 / 194. That assumes every string of the language is drawn before a flush, so it is an upper bound.

findings.title: When a font's 4 atlases are full, cacheGlyph drops the glyph and FreeType re-renders it on every draw and measure
findings.problem: Nothing is evicted. Once all ATLAS_MAX (4) 256x256 atlases of a font are full, glyphAtlasPlace returns 0 and cacheGlyph returns NULL with the entry still invalid. The character is not drawn, the text closes up around it, and every later renderString or calcDimensions call runs FT_Load_Char + FT_Render_Glyph for it again and walks all four atlas trees. At 720p (native 720 lines, renderman.cpp:74) the 17 px font is ~25 px, so a CJK glyph cell is ~25x26 and an atlas holds ~90-100, ~400 per font. Japanese.yml alone has 490 distinct CJK characters.
findings.fix: On a placement failure, mark the entry valid with no allocation (as glyphAtlasPlace already does for empty bitmaps), so a full atlas costs nothing per frame. To make the characters show, raise ATLAS_MAX to 8: atlases are created lazily, so only a font that fills four pays 64 KB per extra atlas.
findings.justification: The problem is missing CJK characters, plus FreeType re-rasterising every missing glyph on the GUI thread each frame. Caching the failure is one assignment. Raising ATLAS_MAX is a constant change that allocates nothing for fonts that never need it, which makes it the simplest way to fit a CJK UI at 720p.
findings.benefit: Stops per-frame FreeType re-rendering of every glyph that does not fit (INFERRED: tens of microseconds each on the EE). With ATLAS_MAX 8, CJK UIs at 720p/576p keep all their characters (capacity arithmetic INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read fntsys.cpp:545-578 (returns 0 after ATLAS_MAX), 608-625 (isValid stays 0 on failure, so the next call loads again) and atlas.cpp:105-139 and 164-177 (guillotine split, width+1 x height+1 per glyph). updateAspectRatioLocked fntsys.cpp:654-674: char size 17 at 72*hs DPI, hs = native/480. renderman.cpp:74: 720p row 1280x720 (hs 1.5). The python count gives 490 distinct CJK characters in lng/fork/Japanese.yml, 645 in SChinese. Capacity: 256/25 x 256/26 = 10 x 9 = 90 per atlas (INFERRED; real glyph sizes depend on the language font).

findings.title: cacheGlyph runs one or two FreeType cmap lookups for every non-ASCII character on every draw and measure once a fallback font is loaded
findings.problem: The fallback test (two FT_Get_Char_Index calls) runs before the glyph-cache lookup, so a cached glyph still pays it on every renderString and calcDimensions call. fntRenderStringFit measures a string several times a frame. This runs on the GUI thread whenever the optional font_CJK/font_Japanese file was found (lngInitFallbackFont), for every character >= 0x80: every CJK glyph of a CJK UI font, and twice for every CJK game title character drawn from the fallback.
findings.fix: In cacheGlyph, return the active font's own valid entry first, then the fallback font's valid entry for the same codepoint. A fallback entry only becomes valid through this redirect, and every font load flushes all caches. Only on a miss in both, run the two cmap lookups as now.
findings.justification: It adds one extra cache probe (~3 lines) to remove up to two cmap binary searches per character per pass on the GUI thread. It is the smallest change that makes cached glyphs free.
findings.benefit: Removes ~1-2 FT_Get_Char_Index binary searches per drawn or measured CJK character per frame (INFERRED ~0.5-1 us each, so ~0.5-2 ms per frame on a CJK game list). Applies only when the fallback font exists.
findings.evidence: Read fntsys.cpp:581-638: fallback condition at 586-591 is evaluated before glyphPageOk / isValid at 598-610. fallbackFontId_ is set only by loadFallback (fntsys.cpp:442-459), called only from lngInitFallbackFont (lang.cpp:424-441), which opl.cpp:1741 calls at boot. The fallback slot id is never returned to callers, so its entries become valid only via this redirect. Every loadFile/loadDefault flushes all fonts (fntsys.cpp:409, 669-675). The per-lookup cost is INFERRED, not measured.
